help.help_2: TexCom e u thusa ho bua ka ho thaepa kapa ka ho khetha lipoleloana tse seng li entsoe, 'me e li buela holimo.
help.help_3: U sebelisa TexCom ho sebatli sa Marang-rang. Ntho e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe mona e sebetsa ntle le likarolo tse tšoailoeng lisebelisoa feela, tse hlokang app ea TexCom bakeng sa iPhone, iPad kapa Mac.
help.help_13: Ngola ka har'a lebokose le mosehla, ebe o tobetsa Bua.
help.help_14: Tobetsa poleloana ho e kenya lebokoseng, ebe o tobetsa Bua. U ka eketsa lipoleloana tse 'maloa, kapa ua thaepa tse ling ho li potoloha.
help.help_15: Mantsoe a mang a behiloe ho ho bua hang-hang ha o a tlanya ("Molaetsa oa hang-hang", sheba Editing).
help.help_16: Lebokose la mongolo le lona ke ho batlisisa. Ha u ntse u ngola, lenane le bontša lipoleloana tse nang le mantsoe ho tloha ha u qeta ho qetela, phegelwana, letshwao la dipotso (le tse ding). Tlanya e le 'ngoe ebe e nkela mantsoe ao sebaka. Mohlala, thaepa Ke khathetse. tee'me u tlanye "Hase senoelo sa ka sa tee." Mohala oaMatchingo bontša ha lenane le ntse le tlhotloa; tlanya eona ✕ ho bona poleloana e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe hape.
help.help_17: Likhaoletsa: thaepa tsela e khaoletsang ea poleloana e lateloang ke / ebe e fetoha poleloana kaofela. Ka mohlala, haeba "Hello" e na le tsela ea ho khaoletsa h, ho ngola h/ ho fana ka "Hello".
help.help_18: Poleloana e nang le [***] e kenya lebitsong la hau (Litlhophiso> Lebitso la hau).
help.help_20: Ho skrineng se patisaneng likonopo tse ling li ea ho menu ea ⋯ qetellong ea toolbar.
help.help_22: Hlakola lebokose la mongolo (le nalane ea moqoqo).
help.help_24: Etsolla le Etsa hape liphetoho ho lebokose la mongolo.
help.help_26: Mamela molekane wa hao: o bulela kapa o tima maekrofounu (e kgubedu ha o mametse). lisebelisoa feela
help.help_28: Tlhokomeliso: e letsa tloloko ho hapa tlhokomelo ea motho.
help.help_32: SOS: beps S-O-S ka Morse code ho letsetsa thuso.
help.help_34: Ratoang: e eketsa se ka har'a lebokose la mongolo ho tseo u li ratang.
help.help_36: Edita: e bulela le ho tima Edit mode (sheba Editing).
help.help_38: Litlhophiso, moo u tla boela u fumane Thuso ena.
help.help_40: Arolelana mongolo o ka lebokoseng (mohlala ka molaetsa).
help.help_42: Lipolelo li arotsoe ka mekhahlelo. Tlanya sehlopha ho bona mantsoe a sona; Kaofela e bontša poleloana e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe.
help.help_43: Mohaleng o ts'oereng hantle, tlanya Likarolo kaholimo ho mantsoe ho khetha e le 'ngoe.
help.help_44: Lithatohatsi li na le lipolelo tseo u li sebelisang haholo. Kenya e 'ngoe ka konopo ea ♡, kapa tšoaea Lithatohatsi ha u hlophisa poleloana.
help.help_45: Swaepa (kapa tsamaisa) manane ho bona tse ling.
help.help_46: Ho skrine se seholoanyane, hula bar pakeng tsa litšiea tse peli ho etsa hore e be bophara.
help.help_47: Ho eketsa le ho fetola mantsoe
help.help_48: Tobetsa ✎ Edita. Polelo ka 'ngoe le sehlopha se fumana konopo ea ✎, 'me "+ Eketsa poleloana" / "+ Eketsa sehlopha" e hlaha ka holimo ho manane.
help.help_49: Ho sehlophisi u ka fetola mantsoe, letšoao (thaepa kapa u khomarele emoji), khaoletso, le hore e leng lihlopha life.
help.help_50: Molaetsa oa hang-hang: poleloana e bua hang ha u e tlanya.
help.help_51: Delete e tlose (o tla kopuwa ho netefatsa).
help.help_52: Ka mokhoa oa ho Fetola, hula sets'oants'o ⠿ ho ho hlophisa bocha lipolelo kapa likarolo.
help.help_53: Tobetsa ✎ Edita hape ha o qetile.
help.help_56: Tobetsa 🎙 mme TexCom e mamele motho eo o buang le yena. Seo ba se buang se hlaha ka holimo skrineng, 'me TexCom e ka fana ka maikutlo a likarabo. lisebelisoa feela
help.help_57: Litlhophiso> Smart AI> Qala ho mamela ha TexCom e bula e bulela microphone nako le nako ha o qala TexCom.
help.help_58: Ha keyboard e hoketsoe, motho e mong a ka tobetsa konopo ea ` (e haufi le 1 kapa Z), a thaepe, ebe o tobetsa Enter. Mantsoe a bona a hlaha ka holimo ho skrine. Esc e hlakotse.
help.help_59: Mohaleng oa bona kapa komporong ea bona, kae kapa kae
help.help_60: Litlhophiso> Moqoqo> Qala moqoqo… e u fa sehokelo le khoutu e khutšoane. Arolelana sehokelo (molaetseng kapa lengolo-tsoibila), kapa u ba lumelle hore ba hlahlobe khoutu ea QR.
help.help_61: Ba ka sebelisa mohala kapa khomphutha efe kapa efe (ba bula sehokelo feela), kapa TexCom ea bona (Kena moqoqong…, ebe u beha sehokelo kapa u thaepe khoutu).
help.help_62: Ha ba leka ho kena, TexCom e u botsa: Lumella kapa Hana. Ha ho motho ea kopanelang ntle le polelo ea hau. Puisano ka 'ngoe e na le sehokelo se secha.
help.help_63: Seo u se buang se hlaha se le seholo haholo skrineng sa bona. Seo ba se ngolang se hlaha ho nalane ea hau ea puisano.
help.help_64: Sebaka se kaholimo ho meqoqo se bontša hore na u bua le mang. Tobetsa Qetellong ho qetela.
help.help_65: Bala melaetsa ea molekane holimo (Litlhophiso> Moqoqo) ba bua melaetsa ea bona le uena.
help.help_66: Ka bobeli le hloka khokahano ea inthanete.
help.help_68: Litlhophiso> Smart AI> Bontša histori ea puisano e bontša moqoqo ho fihlela joale, tlas'a lihlopha (kapa ka holim'a lipolelo tsa mohala o ts'oaretsoeng). E lula e bonahala nakong ea moqoqo holim'a marang-rang.
help.help_69: Hula bar ka holimo ho eona ho e etsa e kholo kapa e nyane.
help.help_71: Tsena li sebetsa ka lekunutu sesebelisoa sa hau (Apple Intelligence), kahoo ha ho letho leo u le buang le romelloang kae kapa kae. Ba hloka iPhone, iPad kapa Mac ea morao-rao.
help.help_72: Likarabo tse sisintsoeng: ka mor'a hore uena kapa molekane oa hau le bue, ho hlaha likarabo tse ka bang tharo holimo lethathamong la lipolelo, tse tšoailoeng 🧠. Tlanya e le 'ngoe ho e sebelisa. Tlanya ^ ho kopa litlhahiso tse ncha.
help.help_73: Likhakanyo tsa mantsoe a latelang: ha u ntse u ngola, mohlomong mantsoe a latelang a hlaha e le likonopo. Tlanya e le 'ngoe ho e kenya.
help.help_74: Smart Atolosa: ngola molaetsa o mokgutshwane mme o o qetele ka @ (mohlala need drink@) ebe TexCom e e ngola e le polelo e felletseng. E bulele ho Litlhophiso> Smart AI.
help.help_75: AI persona (Settings> Smart AI> Edit AI persona ...): bolella AI ka uena, joalo ka molumo oa hau, maemeli, mokhoa oa ho bua ka thuso ea hau ea puisano, le ntho leha e le efe eo e lokelang ho e tseba, kahoo litlhahiso li utloahala joaloka uena.
help.help_78: Puo: khetha lentsoe, molumo, lebelo le molumo, ebe o tobetsa Lentsoe la ho leka ho le utloa.
help.help_80: Boitsebiso: kenya lipolelo ho tsoa faeleng ea mongolo, bula kapa u boloke poleloana, kapa u arolelane.
help.help_82: Ho ntlafatsa TexCom ha ho fetole kapa ho tlosa lipolelo tsa hau, lihlopha kapa litlhophiso.
help.help_83: Ha ntlafatso e tlisa lipoleloana tse ncha, TexCom e u bolella hang, 'me Litlhophiso> Lintlha li bontša Kenya lipoleloana tse ncha tsa TexCom…. Ba kena sehlopheng sa Mafoko a macha hore o shebelle. Boloka tseo u li ratang 'me u hlakole tse ling kaofela.
help.help_84: Ho boloka kopi, kapa ho isa lipoleloana tsa hau sesebelisoa se seng, sebelisa Litlhophiso> Lintlha> Boloka sete ea polelo… le Bula poleloana e hlophisitsoeng….
